# Techförvaltaren: Därför tecknar jag inte Anthropic

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-11-19  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This was an EFN Börslunch episode on the day of Anthropic's IPO. Guest Inge Heidorn (techförvaltaren) said he did not subscribe for Anthropic shares because its business model is not settled yet. He prefers to get the same exposure through the AI compute supply chain: neoclouds like CoreWeave, data-centre operators like Applied Digital and Core Scientific, and chipmakers like Nvidia and Micron. Guest Caroline Ortmark warned that companies buying AI have no clear strategy. The Stockholm news segment covered Coor's acquisition, RVRC's report, ABG's upgrade of Truecaller and Green Landscaping's discounted rights issue.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ ANTHROPIC — Anthropic | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest Inge Heidorn did not subscribe in the IPO because the business model is not settled and cannot be modelled. Caroline would invest in it.

#### Reasoning

Guest view (Inge): the fund only buys companies it can value with a sensible valuation. He expects Anthropic to move into cybersecurity and software within 6 months to reach its sales forecasts, so the outcome cannot be put into numbers. He gets the same exposure more cheaply through the supply chain. The other guest, Caroline, disagreed and would put 1M SEK into Anthropic, so the view is mixed.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the business model stabilises and becomes possible to value
- if the valuation falls toward fundamentals

> *"Och det gör att den här osäkerheten har jag svårt att sätta i pränt på siffror. Och det gör att vi inte tecknar kurserna."*

---

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Inge would get AI exposure through chips instead of Anthropic: 75% gross margin, $380bn in commitments, demand for compute drives everything.

#### Reasoning

Guest view (Inge): if Anthropic succeeds, the whole chain benefits. Compute prices are up 250% this year and capacity is sold out. Nvidia's commitments and the SpaceX/Anthropic 10 GW deal point to sustained chip demand. Asked where to invest 1M, his answer was chips.

#### Sell Triggers

- if demand for compute weakens
- if AI lab profitability fails to show up
- if export restrictions widen

> *"Sen går du till nästa steg, som Nvidia, med 75% gross marginal eller micro. Så hela kedjan gynnas."*

---

### 🟢 CRWV — CoreWeave | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Named as a neocloud with 70% gross margin through which Inge gets Anthropic exposure.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: as a supplier to Anthropic, CoreWeave benefits directly if Anthropic succeeds. Inge said he gets the same exposure by buying other companies at other valuations. It was not named as an explicit holding.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Anthropic's growth stalls
- if compute prices fall

> *"så kommer de gå till neokloudbolagen, till exempel Coreving kund, leverantör till dem, och de har 70% gross marginal."*

---

### 🟢 MU — Micron | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Named with Nvidia as a chip-layer beneficiary in Inge's 'buy the chain' thesis.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: memory is part of the compute chain that gains from AI demand. Inge's 1M answer was chips. It was only mentioned briefly.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory pricing turns down
- if AI capex slows

> *"Sen går du till nästa steg, som Nvidia, med 75% gross marginal eller micro."*

---

### 🟢 TRUE-B — Truecaller | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Cited analyst: ABG upgraded to buy and raised the target price to SEK 35 from 23. Shares up about 10%.

#### Reasoning

This is cited analyst opinion (ABG), not the hosts' view. The new target is more than 50% above the old one, which suggests a much stronger earnings outlook. The market reacted with a 10% rise.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the share price passes the SEK 35 target
- if ABG revises its view
- if the next quarterly report disappoints

> *"Truecaller fått en köpstämpel från ABG. Riktkursen höjs samtidigt till 35 kronor från tidigare 23."*

---

### 🟠 COOR — Coor | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Acquisition of Norwegian Insider Group expected to lift EPS about 25% one year after closing. Shares up about 7%.

#### Reasoning

News item only, with no opinion from the hosts. The large expected EPS lift is a positive catalyst, but closing and integration still have to happen.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the deal fails to close
- if integration fails to deliver the EPS lift

> *"De köper alltså norska Insider Group som förväntas öka vinster per aktie med cirka 25 procent ett år efter slutförandet av affären."*

---

### ⛔ GREEN — Green Landscaping | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Deeply discounted rights issue: about SEK 450M at SEK 8, more than 50% below the close. Shares down about 25%.

#### Reasoning

News item only. A deep-discount rights issue means heavy dilution and suggests balance-sheet stress, which puts short-term pressure on the shares.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the issue is fully subscribed and debt is cut, improving the outlook

> *"Emissionen omfattar högst 6 miljoner nya aktier till teckningskursen 8 kronor. Över 50 % under onsdagens stängningskurs."*
